NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 13, 11:14 AM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 18.0 DraftKings points for $8,100, against Arizona. Chris Olave (17.0, $7,600) and Drake London (15.3, $7,000) are next.

Wan'Dale Robinson returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.46 projected points per $1,000 at $4,500.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 13, 11:14 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 6

Puka Nacua, LAR vs ARI ($8,100)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 18.0 DraftKings points at $8,100. That is 1.0 points clear of Chris Olave. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 26.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.22 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 25 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 18.0 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 37.7, and he holds 22% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 12.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 32.5 in a game totaled at 52.5.

Chris Olave, NO at NYG ($7,600)

Chris Olave projects 2nd at the position with 17.0 DraftKings points at $7,600. The model gives him 9.6 targets on 36.7 routes. The salary works out to 2.24 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 25 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Olave averaged 17.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.6 and a ceiling of 36.1, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New Orleans is a 1.5-point underdog on the road against the Giants, with an implied team total of 22 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Drake London, ATL vs CHI ($7,000)

Drake London projects 3rd at the position with 15.3 DraftKings points at $7,000. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 24.3 routes. The current projection of 15.3 compares with a saved model baseline of 14.6. The salary works out to 2.19 projected points per $1,000, 10th of 25 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations London averaged 15.1 points with a simulated floor of 4.2 and a ceiling of 36.0, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 3-point underdog at home against Chicago, with an implied team total of 23.25 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Value: Wan'Dale Robinson, TEN at IND ($4,500)

Wan'Dale Robinson projects for 11.1 DraftKings points at $4,500, which works out to 2.46 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 25 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 6.9 targets on 31.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 11.1 points with a simulated floor of 4.0 and a ceiling of 23.1, and he holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tennessee is a 7-point underdog on the road against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 18.75 in a game totaled at 44.5.
